build_sparse_multi_head_attention: build a SparseMultiHeadAttention module with self attention, full mode, and configurable number of heads
build_cross_attention: build a SparseMultiHeadAttention module in cross attention mode with separate query and key-value projections
build_serialized_attention: build a SparseMultiHeadAttention module using serialized attention mode with a specified window size and serialize mode
build_windowed_attention: build a SparseMultiHeadAttention module using windowed attention mode with a configurable window size and shift window
build_sparse_rms_norm: build a SparseMultiHeadRMSNorm layer that normalizes sparse tensor features across the last dimension with learnable gamma
